The organization focuses on citizen-centric service delivery, partnering with federal agencies to modernize and secure mission-critical systems. Varmoda connects systems, data, and platforms using a five-layer approach encompassing engagement, data, orchestration, decisioning, and capacity. Team members collaborate closely with federal stakeholders to design and implement scalable, resilient solutions that advance public-sector missions. The environment emphasizes innovation, accountability, and practical impact on federal service outcomes. Role Description The VMWare Aria Consultant is a full-time, on-site role based in McLean, VA, responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing VMware Aria configurations within complex federal IT environments. The consultant will work with infrastructure and cloud teams to build and maintain virtualized platforms, automate provisioning and lifecycle management, and support integration with existing systems and tools. Daily activities include deploying and configuring VMware Aria components, performing performance tuning and capacity planning, and resolving technical issues across infrastructure, networking, and Windows environments. The role involves collaborating with project managers, security teams, and federal clients to gather requirements, document solutions, and ensure compliance with agency standards and best practices. The consultant will provide ongoing operational support, create technical documentation, and contribute to continuous improvement of Varmoda’s cloud and virtualization offerings. Proficiency in troubleshooting complex technical issues across VMware Aria stacks, virtual machines, and related services. VMware Certified Professional (VCP) or equivalent VMware certification demonstrating deep knowledge of VMware technologies. Solid networking skills, including TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, firewalls, and integration of virtual networks with on-prem and cloud systems. Experience managing Windows server environments, including configuration, patching, and integration with VMware-based infrastructure. Hands-on experience with VMware Aria (formerly vRealize) suite, including automation, operations, and orchestration tools. Familiarity with federal IT environments, security requirements, and compliance frameworks (e.g., FISMA, NIST) is beneficial. Ability to document architectures and procedures clearly and to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Ability to work on-site in McLean, VA, and collaborate in cross-functional teams supporting federal missions.

review_candidates.title: ServiceNow Operations System Administator
review_candidates.description: Job Description NetImpact Strategies is seeking a Senior Operations System Administrator to provide infrastructure-oriented ServiceNow platform operations for a Federal Agency. This role anchors early and late-window operations and provides deep troubleshooting across MID Servers, supporting VMs/operating systems, queues, connectivity, maintenance, security controls, recovery, and service restoration while working closely with the ServiceNow System Administrator and implementation team. Work schedule: Monday-Friday, representative early shift of approximately 6:00am-2:30am and late shift of approximately 1:30 p.m.-10:00 p.m. Eastern; planned after-hours maintenance, continuity testing, upgrades, and rotating on-call support as required. This position requires U.S. citizenship and a post-award Government background investigation. Key Responsibilities Provide early or late-window operational ownership for ServiceNow platform-support infrastructure, with emphasis on MID Servers, supporting VMs/operating systems, connectivity, queues, maintenance, and continuity. Perform deep troubleshooting, preventative/corrective maintenance, performance monitoring, configuration management, and restoration across ServiceNow operational dependencies. Investigate MID Server availability, ECC queue conditions, authentication/connectivity failures, certificate/credential issues, resource capacity, and infrastructure anomalies; coordinate with platform, network, cloud, identity, and security teams. Execute and document planned maintenance, patching, restart/recovery, backup/restore, continuity, and disaster-recovery activities in accordance with approved change and security processes. Provide Tier 2/Tier 3 support for incidents, problems, catalog tasks, and platform requests; maintain accurate ServiceNow records, SLA evidence, restoration notes, and handoffs. Implement and monitor infrastructure and platform security controls, log/audit requirements, privileged/service-account dependencies, and operational evidence; escalate suspicious activity immediately. Support new integrations and platform changes by validating runtime prerequisites, certificates, network paths, service accounts, MID selection/capacity, and production readiness. Coordinate ServiceNow and infrastructure vendor support cases and preserve diagnostic evidence needed for root cause and problem management. Maintain operations procedures, queue-management instructions, recovery steps, environment baselines, asset/dependency information, and transition documentation. Provide structured handoff to/from the early operations team so unresolved incidents, changes, security actions, and integration conditions retain clear ownership across the service window. Qualifications Required Qualifications and Certifications Five or more years providing operational support to enterprise ServiceNow implementations, including complex troubleshooting and production support. Strong experience with ServiceNow MID Servers plus Windows/Linux system administration, VM operations, networking/connectivity fundamentals, certificates, authentication, queues, and service accounts. Experience with configuration/change management, preventive maintenance, security controls, backups/recovery, incident/problem management, and off-hours production support. Multiple ServiceNow certifications relevant to the supported environment; CSA strongly preferred or required where mandated by the applicable labor category. Experience coordinating ServiceNow Support cases and cross-team troubleshooting in a shared enterprise environment. Ability to work the assigned coverage window and participate in planned after-hours/on-call events. U.S. citizenship and ability to satisfy High Risk IT background-investigation and sensitive-information requirements. Preferred Qualifications And Certifications Federal consulting or financial-regulatory experience. Experience with CyberArk or equivalent privileged-account management, Splunk or similar monitoring, and ServiceNow Discovery/ITOM. Experience supporting continuity exercises and production releases in multi-vendor environments.
